Title: Public Preview: GraphQL resolvers for Azure Cosmos DB, Azure SQL in Azure API Management

Body.Content:
GraphQL has experienced a remarkable surge in popularity among developers. Its ability to streamline data fetching by enabling API consumers to request the data they need precisely has transformed client application development. GraphQL has emerged as a preferred choice for building modern, scalable, and responsive applications. Azure API Management already supports securely publishing GraphQL services as APIs and creating new GraphQL APIs from existing REST APIs. 

Today we’re further expanding Azure API Management support for GraphQL. We are thrilled to announce the public preview of Azure Cosmos DB and Azure SQL resolvers for GraphQL in Azure API Management. This new capability enables customers to define new GraphQL APIs in Azure API Management that expose data stored in Azure Cosmos DB and Azure SQL databases. With the Azure Cosmos DB and Azure SQL resolvers, customers can create GraphQL endpoints using a straightforward low-code approach with Azure Cosmos DB or Azure SQL as their backends, reducing complexity and accelerating the development of sophisticated GraphQL APIs.  

To learn more about building GraphQL APIs with Azure Cosmos DB and Azure SQL in Azure API Management, check out the following resources: 

Support for GraphQL APIs - Azure API Management | Microsoft Learn 

Add a synthetic GraphQL API to Azure API Management | Microsoft Learn 

Start leveraging the power of GraphQL with Azure Cosmos DB and Azure SQL today!
